OUR SERVICES
We don't just sell the machine. Our own technicians install it and advise you on the equipment your line needs. Preventive maintenance with genuine parts, hands-on training, and garment construction analyzed operation by operation. 🛠️
👉 Swipe to see all four. Which one do you need? Write to us.

MORGAN TECNICA REX PRO 50/70/90
Advanced solutions for the cutting room, designed for superior performance. Up to 9 cm compressed ply, cutting speed up to 65 m/min and up to 50% energy savings compared with traditional technologies. ✂️
👉 Ask about this machine. Write to us.

BROTHER NEXIO T-8722D
Twin needle direct drive lock stitcher with large hook and thread trimmer, built for heavy materials. 550 W AC servo motor, 3,000 sti/min, 7 mm stitch length, needle breakage prevention while reverse sewing and switchable needle or lower feed. 🧵
👉 Ask about this machine. Write to us.

JUKI LZ-2290C
Semi-dry head, digital zigzag stitch sewing system with rotary active tension — an even stitch throughout. Motor-driven feed, multi-layered portion detection, up to 5,000 sti/min, 8 mm zigzag width and 20 standard patterns. 🌀
👉 Ask about this machine. Write to us.

REPUESTOS GENUINOS
Contamos con el inventario de repuestos genuinos más grande de Centroamérica, para todas las marcas que representamos, y con servicio técnico propio que mantiene su producción trabajando. 🔧
👉 Habla con un asesor. ¡Te respondemos hoy!

PEGASUS W3500P / W3600P
Oil barrier type interlock stitch machines — flat bed (W3500P) and cylinder bed (W3600P). Fully automatic, up to 6,000 sti/min, built for increased production efficiency, ease of operation and efficient maintenance. 20 models between both series. 🧵
👉 Ask about a model. Write to us.
